parent.scope: accepted nested secondary DP and depot reorder topology

source.boundary: SPRU is a partially repairable secondary item in an LRU. The same depot policy as the seed-1 repair case uses accumulated DIRPF 0.5 and reorder-position DISCF 0.5.

predeclared_native_acceptance: All 23 author-populated tables round-trip exactly; five guarded native stages exit zero; conversion has zero errors and only the expected ENLOG warning #108; event log and report are nonempty and parseable.

Critical aircraft failures lead to the inherited LRU exchange, and each removed failed LRU reveals a nested failed SPRU. The LRU receives a stocked SPRU through the item-specific SURP task and returns to LRU stock while the removed SPRU follows its depot path.

Trace distinct failed SPRU individuals: one reaches depot direct repair for one hour and returns to stock; a later one is explicitly discarded at depot, never repaired or returned, and triggers one-unit reorder. A new individual arrives after the configured one-hour lead.
A still later SPRU may begin repair near the 36-hour horizon. Report it as unfinished if no completion event occurs; do not infer full depot stock or completed maintenance from aircraft readiness.

Reconcile LRU/SPRU physical identities, base/depot stock, transport, three mission outcomes, 72 half-hour System/Stock bins, failure/repair metrics, backlog and terminal state. Bind invocation and closure to frozen source and raw SHA-256 hashes, with independent read-only replay.
limits: This seed-7 case and the seed-1 companion show observed SPRU repair and discard/reorder paths, not a 50/50 frequency law.
Other fractions, stations, seeds, GUI-only behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
